botfather_commands.description: Invite a friend to a Private 3D Table

botfather_setup_steps: 1. Open @BotFather in Telegram and send /newbot (or select your existing bot).
2. Send /newapp to @BotFather, select your bot, and enter 'Royal Backgammon 3D'.
3. When prompted for the Web App URL, paste your deployed HTTPS application URL.
5. Send /setmenubutton to @BotFather, select your bot, paste the HTTPS URL, and set button title to 'PLAY 3D BACKGAMMON'.
